kind: Frozen factual-error controlled audit; no human ratings or causal proof beyond the specified interventions

automated_checks.note: Equality, coverage and EOS are software observations, not factuality ratings.

ai_assisted_source_comparisons.suspected_cause: Checkpoint/search entity-role and cross-match blending; preprocessing/context sensitivity also exists.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.controlled_evidence: Raw direct output with app settings matches saved app IDs. Original 35/100 recipe and adaptive Medium both say Real beat Bilbao; Stanford tokenization leaves the reversed result and wrong Ligue1/eighth-place relationship. NLTK400 prefix changes result to defeat but still wrongly gives Bale the goal; Stanford400 reverses it again. LSTM is correct on expanded input but wrong at400 under both tokenizers. No consistent benefit from reverting the window.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.error_transition: Unchanged across checkpoint-recipe versus adaptive decoding and expanded Stanford preprocessing. NLTK400 removes the result reversal but leaves another factual error; this partial diagnostic is not a full-article fix.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.proposed_fix_or_limitation: No production change supported. Treat as a model/search factuality limitation with context/tokenization sensitivity; do not revert all models to400 or claim source coverage establishes accuracy.

ai_assisted_source_comparisons.suspected_cause: Unsupported attribution generated by checkpoint, plausibly a learned opinion-summary pattern; mechanism not proved.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.controlled_evidence: All five BART controls generate Frida Ghitis, including untouched checkpoint generation defaults. Raw single-pass IDs match app settings exactly. Source body names neither Ghitis nor reference author Donna Brazile; only the reference supplies Brazile. PEGASUS instead invents Eric Liu, Transformer Debbie Wasserman Schultz; documented decoding does not recover supported authorship.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.error_transition: Unchanged under every BART length/EOS control; already present before display cleanup.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.proposed_fix_or_limitation: No decoding fix demonstrated. Missing source byline is a data constraint; the model must not guess an author. Human/source-grounding review remains necessary; no hardcoded name correction or invented author lookup applied.

ai_assisted_source_comparisons.suspected_cause: Decoder salience failure on short source; adaptive minimum changes detail quantity but does not explain loss of main event.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.controlled_evidence: Complete81-word article fits every backend. All four still omit car bomb/seven killed/23 injured under direct checkpoint-recipe/default decoding. Increasing BART minimum to checkpoint56 changes25 to41 words and adds civilian/child casualties, but not the bombing event or toll. HF maximum-only and forced-EOS-only controls do not restore it. Stanford preprocessing changes p.m. handling and some wording, not the missing event.400 and1024 use the same complete tokens here.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.error_transition: Main-event omission unchanged across every tested documented/adaptive control. Shorter minimum removes some secondary detail; it did not introduce the central omission.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.proposed_fix_or_limitation: No supported length fix. More minimum tokens add detail without guaranteeing main-event selection; retain coherent EOS preferences and report this salience limitation.

ai_assisted_source_comparisons.suspected_cause: Checkpoint near-duplicate generation; exact-sentence deduplication does not catch paraphrased repetition.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.controlled_evidence: The same81-word output and token IDs occur under checkpoint defaults, EOS-unforced, maximum-only, minimum-only and direct app settings. Both repeated claims already occur in raw output, before newline cleanup. All terminate naturally before the native cap. Checkpoint no_repeat_ngram_size is0, inherited by app; no extra repetition setting was swept.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.error_transition: Unchanged across all five HF controls; not introduced by adaptive maximum or merge.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.proposed_fix_or_limitation: No production change proposed from one example. Semantic repetition is a known limitation; a repetition-control candidate would require separate validation before adoption.

ai_assisted_source_comparisons.suspected_cause: Chunk-level content selection and limited global context; concatenating chunk summaries can also retain tangential detail.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.controlled_evidence: All four process two complete source chunks, covering every source character. Transformer omits Monohm/Runcible in the first raw chunk output under both35/100 recipe and adaptive settings; Stanford gives the same displayed chunk outputs. Replaying direct outputs through the identical source-order merge exactly reproduces the app, with zero extra generative consolidation. BART/PEGASUS first chunks retain the names; LSTM retains Monohm but omits Runcible.400/1024 whole-source prefixes omit tails and are explicitly partial diagnostics.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.error_transition: Entity omission already present before merging; unchanged under checkpoint-recipe and tokenizer controls. No extra consolidation decode exists in this example to cause it.
ai_assisted_source_comparisons.proposed_fix_or_limitation: No merge fix supported. This audit does not establish that chunk boundaries are optimal or that genuinely deeper hierarchical consolidation is faithful; it isolates where this omission first appears.

production_recommendation: Retain current implementation/settings. No tested intervention consistently resolves the five failures. No candidate promoted; separate reserved validation42-47 was not run because there is no supported production-change proposal. Do not infer benefit from selective disappearance of one error.

preprocessing_audit.documented: Stanford CoreNLP3.7 PTBTokenizer with preserveLines, followed by lowercase; original script adds missing terminal periods by original story line, uses non-anonymized words, target sentence tags; pinned OpenNMT dynamic_dict/share_vocab and source400/target100 convention. Own checkpoint vocabularies and dynamic copy mapping retained in direct Translator.translate.
preprocessing_audit.observed_discrepancy: NLTK approximation can retain terminal period on a word immediately before a quote (front., boost., together., discord.) and split abbreviations differently (p.m., Mo., Det.). Stanford tokens differ, and generation can change, but failure removal is not consistent.
preprocessing_audit.limits: Original .story line boundaries and original OpenNMT prepared corpus are unavailable. Stanford3.7 reproduces the documented tokenization/lowercasing on this exact flattened HF source, not every historical caption-period repair or corpus packaging step. Source text is unchanged; target <t> tags are not inserted into source.
preprocessing_audit.historical_recipe_ambiguity: Pinned prose says alpha .8; explicit CNN/DM command says .9. Use command .9 matching app. Today's website uses beam 10; pinned checkpoint-era document uses 5. OpenNMT has no embedded HF-style generation config; use documented recipe plus pinned translator max_length default 100.

template_reference_audit.contents: Row10 (March10,2015) introduces international stories about a solar plane, Asian craters and Everest. Row14 (March9,2015) introduces Selma, MH370, International Women's Day and unemployment. Both then contain the same transcript-access/roll-call boilerplate. Their identical highlights emphasize transcript/roll-call instructions, not those different episode topics. Every model reproduces closely matching template text, including a reading-comprehension/vocabulary sentence not explicitly present in either article.
template_reference_audit.interpretation: Reference/template artifacts can reward generic language and ignore episode events. This does not prove memorization, training membership or validation leakage. No bad-performing example was excluded; the original40 remain primary and the existing38-page post-hoc sensitivity remains labeled.
